boost.definition: BOOST n (Myth): gain n extra Glow.

cancel.definition: An Interrupt's result: the target card's effect does not happen.

cel.definition: Cel suit: cards whose art style is anime.

chain.definition: A card chains if its suit matches the last card in your Line, or either is Wild.

chain_keyword.definition: CHAIN n (Muse): if this chains, the bonus is +n instead of +1.

dim.definition: DIM n (Tide): the opponent loses n Glow (not below 0).

discard.definition: At the end of your turn, drop cards until you hold 7.

first_light.definition: Tile 41. Not shuffled in; its holder goes first and the other player starts with 2 Glow.

hand.definition: Cards you hold. Start with 5, draw 2 per turn, keep at most 7.

ink.definition: Ink suit: cards whose art style is cartoon or sketch.

interrupt.definition: INTERRUPT n (Shade): when the opponent plays a card, play this from your hand at once to cancel that card's effect.

line.definition: Your row of played cards, in the order played.

normal.definition: NORMAL: no timing rule. Played on your turn, can be interrupted.

photo.definition: Photo suit: cards whose art style is photoreal.

pixel.definition: Pixel suit: cards whose art style is digital, 3d, pixel, abstract, graphic, neon.

play.definition: Put one card from your hand onto the end of your Line.

provenance.definition: The append-only, hash-linked log of a game: every play, interrupt, resolve and score, each pointing to the hash of the record before it.

resolution_order.definition: The fixed order a play is processed in: legality > placement > interrupt > resolve > stop_time > score.

resolve.definition: Apply a played card: its Glow, its chain bonus, then its effect.

sealed.definition: A card for a held tile. Face down, 1 Glow, no effect, Void, Normal timing.

stop_time.definition: STOP TIME n (Signal): after this resolves, play n more cards this turn.

suit.definition: Which art style family a card belongs to: Photo, Ink, Cel, Pixel, or Void.

timing.definition: When and how a card can act: NORMAL, INTERRUPT, STOP_TIME, UNSTOPPABLE or UNIQUE, each with a value.

turn.definition: Draw 2, play 1 (more with Stop Time), discard to 7. Your Ward ends at the start of your turn.

type.definition: What a card does: Muse, Signal, Myth, Shade, Tide, Oddity, Sealed or Marker. Set by the tile's first motif.

unique.definition: UNIQUE (Oddity, First Light): at most one Unique card in your Line. First Light is one per game.

unstoppable.definition: UNSTOPPABLE (Myth): this card cannot be interrupted.

void.definition: The suit of Sealed cards and First Light. Chains with nothing.

ward.definition: WARD (Shade): you cannot be Dimmed until your next turn starts.

wild.definition: WILD (Oddity): chains with any suit, before or after it.

win.definition: Reach 21 Glow. If the deck and both hands are empty, higher Glow wins.
